details: CIP Safety Ring Protocol Engine (W235) verified cleanly (9/9 stages passed).

standards: ODVA CIP Networks Library Volume 5 (CIP Safety)
Class 0x3B (Safety Connection Object - Ring / Dual Port)

stages.details: Class 0x39, 0x3A, 0x3B, SNN (6 octets), SCID (0x20261006), ring supervisor mode (1), nominal EPI 10ms, watchdog 30ms, beacon 1ms verified.
POU 'CipSafetyRingSync' validated clean with STParser & SecurityGuard; all 10 registers bound (%R1960..%R1967, %M457..%M458).
Anti-ladder security guard intercepted 3/3 prohibited ladder constructs with LadderForbiddenError.
Port 1 and Port 2 active, RING_NORMAL / SUPERVISOR_ACTIVE state; steady beacon frame generation verified.
Channel A / Channel B complement parity and CRC-S1/CRC-S2 verified; 0xEA03 discrepancy fault caught.
Silence monitored; exceeding 30.0 ms watchdog injected 0xEA02 and asserted %M458 safe state.
0xEA05 ring break on Port 2 and 0xEA06 beacon timeout injected; %M458 safe state asserted, rapid recovery < 10ms verified.
Bit-exact synchronization of %R1960..%R1967 and %M457..%M458 verified with signed/unsigned masking.
100 deterministic scan cycles completed cleanly with steady beacon transmission. Heap growth: 3.28 KB (< 100 KB), Peak cycle latency: 2.08 ms (< 250 ms), Mean cycle latency: 0.65 ms (< 25 ms).
